description_en: We offer 2+1 Apartment for Sale. The apartment is located in the Don Bosco area, in the Parallel Living complex. Information about the apartment: • Floor 6 • Gross area 112.90 m2 • Net area 98.39 m2 • Orientation South-West Interior organization: • Living room and kitchen area • 2 bedrooms. • 2 Toilets, one with window • 1 Balcony • Unfurnished • With elevator Other settings: • Thermal double-glazed windows • Parquet, tiles according to the customer's choice • Chiller/multisplit system • Multi street system • Double brick and 10 cm stone wool separation between apartments • Ventilated facade Possibility of choosing the floor and other layouts To visit the property, contact us.
